title: 电影制作时代印刷网格
author: Gadgetify
categories: 应用 / 网页设计,海报 / 传单,3D 渲染,文字 / 排版,产品
prompt_en:
Create a clean 2x2 grid on a pure white studio background featuring 4 large 3D typographic sculptures, each a single character built entirely from filmmaking equipment from a different era. The four glyphs are exactly 4 characters: top-left letter A, top-right number 5, bottom-left letter X, bottom-right number 9. Each character should be front-facing, centered in its quadrant, legible but formed from a dense pile of realistic cinema tools and on-set props, with believable occlusion, weight, and construction logic. Use high-end Cinema 4D product visualization, subtle ambient occlusion, soft three-point studio lighting with a softbox overhead, crisp shadows, realistic materials, and isolated composition.

Top-left: the letter A made from early cinema and silent-era equipment, assembled from vintage wooden tripods, hand-cranked film cameras, brass lenses, reels, megaphones, bell-shaped horns, matte black metal parts, leather straps, and aged wood. Surface qualities should include worn varnished wood, black crackle paint, brass tarnish, scuffed metal, and dusty antique patina. The silhouette should feel chaotic but readable, with tripod legs and old camera bodies defining the A shape.

Top-right: the number 5 made from mid-century analog filmmaking gear, assembled from classic film cameras, magazine reels, metal canisters, brown leather cases, audio accessories, silver fabric packs, director chairs, cylindrical lenses, grips, and vintage production bags. Materials should emphasize brushed aluminum, leather, canvas, rubber, and weathered industrial finishes. The 5 should be chunky and balanced, with stacked props tightly packed into the glyph.

Bottom-left: the letter X made from late 20th century video and broadcast equipment, assembled from shoulder-mount camcorders, portable recorders, battery packs, coiled cables, cassette-like modules, control panels, worn blue and gray plastic housings, and rugged field electronics. Include visible wiring and taped components. Materials should feel utilitarian and slightly battered, with dark plastic, anodized metal, stickers, rubber grips, and yellow accent details. The crossing diagonals of the X must be clear and substantial.

Bottom-right: the number 9 made from contemporary digital cinema and virtual production gear, assembled from modern cinema cameras, compact monitors, LED light panels, drones, gimbals, matte boxes, black modular accessories, and a vivid green chroma screen wrap forming part of the numeral. Include sleek vents, carbon fiber textures, matte black metal, polished glass, and bright green screen fabric as the dominant accent color. The 9 should feel the most modern and refined, with modular precision and clean industrial design.

Keep the background plain and uncluttered, no extra text, no floating objects, no flat typography, no 2D rendering. The sculptures should look like physical objects at realistic scale, highly detailed, photorealistic, and suitable as a graphic design asset.\

prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical streetwear brand launch poster for GORDENINDUSTRY, using a bold editorial collage style with product mockups, handwritten orange annotations, and high-contrast black, white, gray, and vivid orange branding.

Canvas: Portrait 2:3 poster, off-white paper background with subtle grain and faint texture. Center the composition with generous margins and a modern fashion lookbook aesthetic.

Typography: At the top, place one huge condensed uppercase black headline reading “GORDENINDUSTRY”, spanning nearly the full width. Above it add one thin rough black horizontal scribble line. Use tall heavy sans-serif type for brand text. Use orange handwritten script for the slogan Gorden Yeah! across the lower middle.

Layout and discrete elements: Include exactly 7 main collage objects: 1 folded black sweatshirt on the left with small orange “GORDENINDUSTRY” text; 1 grayscale cutout walking model in a black hoodie and loose pants at center, face obscured or simplified; 1 Polaroid-style photo of folded blue jeans in the upper right; 1 white canvas tote bag in the lower center with black “GORDENINDUSTRY” text; 1 translucent plastic garment pouch in the lower left containing a folded light sweatshirt and a small hanging tag; 1 dark gray product box on the right with an orange band labeled “FW / 26” and a small barcode sticker; 1 tall bright orange shopping bag at the lower right with thin orange handles.

Graphic marks and text details: Behind the central objects, add one irregular vivid orange paint-blob shape. Add exactly 2 stamp/label graphics: a rounded rectangle label reading “NEW DROP” with smaller text “SHOP / LOOKBOOK / ABOUT”, and a circular black stamp reading “EST. 2019”. Add exactly 2 starburst doodles: one small orange starburst near the sweatshirt and one larger orange burst near the jeans containing the word FRESH. Add exactly 8 hand-drawn orange arrows or curved directional marks around the collage, pointing between products. Add exactly 3 small white/orange asterisk sparkle marks.

Style: Contemporary urban fashion advertising, magazine cut-and-paste collage, realistic product photography mixed with paper cutouts, slight drop shadows, imperfect edges, energetic hand-drawn orange marker lines, clean negative space, premium but playful streetwear branding.

Constraints: Keep all visible text in English and spelled clearly. Do not add extra products beyond the 7 listed main objects. Avoid photorealistic faces; keep the model face hidden or indistinct. No logos other than the brand name, no watermark, no borders.\

title: 新艺术幻想香水海报
author: VoxCat
categories: 产品营销,海报 / 传单,动漫 / 漫画,插画,角色,产品
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a vertical Art Nouveau luxury perfume advertisement poster featuring VoxCat as an elegant fantasy anime heroine presenting a perfume bottle as the main foreground visual anchor.

Canvas: Tall portrait poster, 2:3 aspect ratio, highly detailed premium packaging illustration, full-bleed composition with a thin black outer border and ornate metallic gold inner frame.

Layout: Center the character from upper torso to hips, angled slightly right, with her arm extended toward the viewer. The perfume bottle must dominate the lower-left foreground and create strong depth of field, appearing much larger than the torso behind it. Place a large plain beige square over the character's face, centered on the face area, as if the face is intentionally blocked. Put one ornate monogram crest in the upper-left corner and one empty decorative product-label plaque in the lower-right corner.

Subject details: One anime-style female fantasy character with long flowing pale blonde hair, wind-swept strands, soft luminous skin, and a white-and-gold armored couture dress with gemstone accents and layered translucent fabric. Her visible hand holds the bottle close to the camera, with carefully drawn fingers and glossy nails. Add exactly 6 large white lilies: 3 lilies tucked into her hair near the upper head, 1 lily in the bottom-left corner, and 2 lilies decorating the lower-right label plaque. Add purple flowers and dark green leaves as secondary botanical decoration around the border.

Perfume bottle: One round faceted glass perfume bottle in the foreground, filled with iridescent lavender-gold liquid. It has a large crystal sphere stopper, a gold engraved cap, and ornate gold filigree on the bottle face. The central medallion shows a small gold cat silhouette framed by laurel branches and a small blue gemstone at the bottom. Use glass refraction, etched details, bright sparkles, and commercial product-photography highlights.

Decorative packaging style: Deep emerald, midnight purple, and antique gold palette; jewel-tone background with circular halo geometry behind the character; swirling vine lines, gold filigree, thin arcs, stars, gemstones, and botanical motifs. The overall feel should be a collectible limited-edition perfume box mixed with a New Art poster.

Text and marks: Upper-left crest contains a large gold letter V inside a heart-shaped vine frame with a dangling purple gemstone. Lower-right plaque is dark purple velvet with ornate gold trim and mostly empty space for copy; add thin blank gold lines near the bottom and a small handwritten brand signature reading voxCat in the lower-right corner.

Constraints: Use exactly 1 character, 1 perfume bottle, 1 upper-left monogram crest, 1 lower-right blank plaque, and 6 large white lilies. Keep the face covered by the plain beige square. No extra readable text besides the monogram letter and brand signature. Make the image polished, intricate, luminous, and high-end, like fantasy character art fused with luxury fragrance packaging.\

She wears a light blue denim baseball cap with a small embroidered Sanrio-style yellow puppy patch and a red bow on the front, plus a distressed/frayed brim. Outfit is a white sleeveless camisole with lace trim and delicate vertical texture, soft feminine summer styling. Skin is fair and softly lit, with a gentle idol-photo look.

Add exactly 4 large translucent pink heart decorations: one at the top left corner, one at the top right corner, one at the bottom left corner, and one at the bottom right corner. On the lower right, show a small dark ceramic bowl filled with white rice on a wooden table. Add another close-up translucent rice-and-chopsticks image behind the lower information panel. The food should look photorealistic, appetizing, warm, and moist.

Make the design feel like a premium competition announcement, with thin gold rules, decorative frames, laurel ornaments, and subtle parchment panels. Keep all Japanese text sharp and readable.

Prize section: Create one framed gold-on-black prize block with exactly 3 prize elements: 1) large main prize text 「賞金総額 1万円」 with gold laurel leaves around the large 「1万円」, 2) right-side text 「最優秀賞：4,000円」 and below it 「(Amazonギフト) 1名」, 3) right-side text 「優秀賞：1,000円」 and below it 「(Amazonギフト) 6名」.

Schedule section: Create a dark framed box with a small calendar icon and the heading 「コンテスト日程」. Include exactly 2 bullet points: 「応募期間：5月31日〜6月5日の23:59」 and 「結果発表：6月7日予定」.

Requirements and judging panel: Create a wide cream parchment panel divided into two columns. Left column heading with an edit/checklist icon: 「提出要件」. Include exactly 8 bullet points: 「テーマはご飯に合うおかず（ご飯に乗せる系もOK）」, 「AIで生成した動画」, 「4K動画（後からアップスケールして4Kにしても良い）」, 「長さは3〜15秒が目安」, 「実在する商品を使うことは禁止」, 「オリジナル作品であること（著作権違反禁止）」, 「商店街オリジナル、または権利処理済素材を使用」, 「センシティブ、または不適切な内容は禁止」, and add the final line 「1人何回でも投稿可能」 as the last bullet if space allows while keeping the panel readable. Right column heading with an eye icon: 「審査基準」. Include the main criterion in large type: 「『いかに美味しそうに見えるか』」 and the note: 「これは美味しそう、と私が思った作品が受賞します」.

Submission section: Near the bottom, create a dark framed box with a paper-airplane icon and heading 「提出方法」. Add the instruction: 「私の固定プロフィールポストを引用する形で投稿してください」.

prompt_en: Create a square, highly detailed cinematic fantasy portrait of a mysterious modern witch standing waist-up inside an antique apothecary and wizard study. The witch has long wavy black hair, a deliberately obscured soft-blurred face with no visible facial features, and wears a tall floppy dark navy-black witch hat decorated with dried lavender, small gold celestial ornaments, moon charms, and delicate lace-like trim. Her outfit is a deep emerald and purple velvet dress under a fitted black coat embroidered with silver constellation lines, zodiac symbols, moons, stars, and occult diagrams, plus a small black crystal pendant necklace. She holds both hands open as if casting a spell, conjuring one continuous luminous ribbon of swirling magic that loops around her hands and across her torso in an S-shaped arc; the magic is iridescent blue, violet, cyan, pink, and gold with sparkling dust, translucent triangular crystal shards, prism refractions, and galaxy-like light trails. The background is a cozy dark wooden magical shop with shelves of glass potion bottles, jars of herbs, crystals, old leather-bound books, dried hanging botanicals, candles, and alchemical objects. On the wall behind her is a large ornate gold-framed painting or portal showing a cosmic nebula sky, stars, and ancient stone ruins in teal-blue light. Foreground bottles are softly blurred with colorful reflections, creating depth of field. Use dramatic warm candlelight mixed with cool magical glow, rich jewel-tone colors, realistic fabric texture, intricate embroidery, sharp details on the hat and coat, volumetric sparkles, shallow depth of field, and a polished GPT-image-2 photoreal fantasy editorial style. Keep exactly one central witch, one continuous magical ribbon, one ornate cosmic framed artwork, and no readable text or watermark.\

prompt_en:
Using REFERENCE_0 as the base breakfast photo, transform it into a stylish social-media morning breakfast post. Keep the actual meal, plate, cup, and tabletop composition essentially the same, but remove the decorative sticker row at the bottom: exactly 6 sheep stickers and 1 pizza sticker must be gone. Add a warm, magazine-like food-photo finish with slightly cleaner lighting and sharper appetizing detail.

Overlay casual white handwritten Japanese annotations directly on the photo, as if drawn with a marker pen, with thin arrows, dotted circles, hearts, underline strokes, and one cloud-shaped callout. Use exactly 10 visible annotation text groups:
1. Large top-left headline: 朝のトーストアート*
2. Small subtitle under it: チーズと野菜のとろ〜りピザトースト
3. Left cloud callout about onion and melted cheese: 「シャキシャキ玉ねぎと とろけるチーズが 最高の相性！♡」
4. Small note near the green pepper with a dotted circle: 「ピーマンのほろ苦さがアクセントに◎」
5. Note pointing to the banana: 「バナナで自然な甘みをプラス♡」
6. Circular note near the egg: 「たんぱく質で一日を元気に！」
7. Note pointing to ketchup on the toast: 「ケチャップはたっぷりめがおいしいよね！」
8. Bottom-left motivational handwritten message with pink underline and heart: ちゃんと食べて、今日もごきげんにいこう。
9. Bottom-center note pointing to the toast crust: 「こんがりトーストにチーズがとろ〜り♡」
10. Bottom-right note pointing to the fruit bowl: 「フルーツとナッツでさっぱり＆カリッといいバランス♪」

Style constraints: make the handwriting look natural, playful, and hand-drawn; keep all text legible in white except the pink underline and heart accent at bottom left. Do not add any new food items, people, logos, watermarks, borders, or extra stickers.\

She wears a sleeveless white-to-lavender-to-deep-purple ombre gradient gown with a V neckline, sheer flowing skirt, and delicate purple floral embroidery on the bodice.
